dataset.title: Schubert Winterreise Dataset
dataset.citation: Christof Weiss et al., Schubert Winterreise Dataset: A Multimodal Scenario for Music Analysis, DOI10.1145/3429743
dataset.audio_license: PDM-1.0 for HU33 per included license; SC06 audio not used
dataset.annotation_process: Related expert revisions, not independent blind annotations. Previous labels were known during revision (Weiss et al.2021, section4.3). The three reference series are reported separately; their agreement is not three independent votes.

scope: Four works from one composer and one performer group; external-domain controls, not artist-disjoint pop generalization

protocol.window_profile: full-track auto-selected profile frozen for all windows, all24 native candidate parity required
protocol.frontend: full recording tuned production chroma; same features across arms
protocol.baseline: default standalone native KeyAnalyzer(audio), not chord-blended analyze output
protocol.secondary: MIREX2017+ weighted duration overlap with both fifths allowed
protocol.reference_policy: each analyst separately, plus all-three-agree common support; no selected or majority analyst

provenance.reference_metadata_reconciliation: After prediction, regenerate grouping metadata from final preparer; audio hashes/durations/all12 annotation hashes and interval arrays identical; every reported score unchanged. Initial frozen reference preserved.
provenance.numerical_correction: After observation, exact symmetric transition formula fixesPython3.11 roundoff instability on uniform evidence. Parameters unchanged; all3 predictionfiles byte-identical and all36 recording/analyst/methodscores identical on frozen observations; no native rerun.

decision: Retain evaluation-only prototype. Pooled scores improve but4/12 recording-analyst comparisons regress; one performer/composer does not justify changing defaults.
